These are experimental pages. Names describe their framing, not their quality. Eight supplied files contain seven distinct designs; the evaluation results cover the first five.

Page evidence

See what each page shows.

The evaluation runner captures rendered pages at desktop and phone widths. A configurable LLM judge can assess them against explicit criteria and cite the evidence behind each finding.

Visitor evidence

Check what people understand.

The study asks you to explain one page in your own words. You download your answers and share them with the organiser. Page scores and visitor comprehension remain separate evidence.

The supplied pages are preserved as source exports. Some demonstrations depend on their original host. No overall winner has been established. Project repository ↗
